During the [[Zaarin insurrection]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] '''destroyed''' platform [[ZA-13]].

==Background==
The second attack on Omar was once again an attempt by rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] to disable the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] ability to produce the [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Advanced]] starfighter. This offensive would leave Zaarin with a technological advantage over the loyal Imperial forces, as he could still produce his own TIE Advanced starfighters. He intended to achieve this by destroying platform [[ZA-13]], the one remaining Imperial TIE Advanced facility in the Omar System that had been recently upgraded and retrofitted in a last ditch effort to continue production of the TIE Advanced.

==The Battle==
ZA-13 was defended by a pair of [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]] and several squadrons of [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] and [[TIE/fc starfighter]]s. These forces had been deployed to safeguard the facility following the [[defense of ZA-13]] by [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. Thrawn was elsewhere leading an attack on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[RS-32]] in an attempt to seize the Rebels' new [[Mag-pulse warhead/Legends|magnetic pulse]] warheads. Zaarin caught on to Thrawn's plans and seized the opportunity to destroy the poorly-defended platform.

Zaarin assaulted the space station with a full force of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bombers]], TIE/IN interceptors, and [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|''Gamma''-class ATR-6 assault transports]]. Despite the presence of the two frigates, they were immediately overwhelmed by Zaarin's superior forces. One frigate was quickly destroyed, with the other barely escaping intact. The assault transports and Bombers began to relentlessly bombard the space station, eventually causing the entire station to break apart in space and explode.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Commander Raveen, order our forces to the Outer Rim. From there, we will launch new attacks against the Emperor.|Demetrius Zaarin|audio=Zaa04-TFCD.flac|<ref name="TF:DE" />}}
The loss of ZA-13 marked the total destruction of the Imperial TIE Advanced plants stationed in the Omar System, effectively impairing the Empire's ability to produce such starfighters. What was worse was that Zaarin had tracked down [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] forces in the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Sceltor]] and made an [[Destruction of the Grappler|unsuccessful ambush]] on Thrawn, which he escaped thanks to [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].

Zaarin then ordered [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Raveen]] to pull his forces out to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], where he renewed his campaign against the Empire. The loss of the TIE Advanced plants was a major setback for the Emperor's forces in their struggle against Zaarin.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first featured in ''[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter: Defender of the Empire]]'', the [[1994]] expansion pack to the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]. The battle is depicted in the final cutscene of the game's eighth tour of campaign, "[[Strategic Warfare]]."

The battle is also explained in the debriefing of the eighth tour of campaign, mission 5 "Capture Mag Pulse Weapon".
